_notes_contact: Civilizations phase 2 (docs/civilizations-phase2-contract.md; played by game/sim/Space/Contact.cs). factions: who may make first contact (Federation only for now). min_level: warp-capable worlds (L5+) may be contacted; below it the contact breaks General Order 1 in a Prime Directive era (rules.json standing) and is a violation: Standing + violation.standing, an incident, and the outcome is always culture shock; before the Prime Directive (ENT, Dawn of Warp) there is no rule, only pre_warp_shock more shock. needs_study: the civilization must be studied (Study = 1) first. The event: the steps below one after the other, each lasting step_seconds (3 x 80 = 4 min); a pick moves to the next step at once, a step whose time runs out takes its first choice (the default). The flagship must stay in orbit: leaving calls it off. Shock chance (%) = base_shock + shock_by_temperament + awareness x shock_per_awareness + pre_warp_shock (below min_level) + every chosen choice's shock, clamped to shock_min..shock_max; rolled on sim.Rng when the last step ends. A choice: shock (percentage points), research (points added to the one-off research boost), standing_if_shock (Starfleet Standing change if it ends in culture shock: the risk of sharing too much), wait_minutes (added to the shock wait). Smooth start: trade partner at once. Culture shock: relations stay at Contact for shock_wait_minutes (then trade partner), the natives' awareness + culture_shock_awareness, culture_shock_minutes of unrest. Trade partner: research_boost points once (into the active surface tech, like observation research), a unique local tech (unique_techs: a pick by the site's seed; its modifiers apply to the player's surface like a researched tech's, never researched in a lab), ally ships (ally.ships_by_stage) and trade income each whole minute (trade.income_per_min x trade.stage_multiplier; allied worlds pay double; into the colony player's stock through the surface's storage: what doesn't fit is lost, latinum always fits; with no surface straight into the stock). membership: trade partner -> candidate needs Standing >= min_standing (players with a Standing meter) and partner_minutes as a trade partner; a fractured world rolls walkout_chance (sim.Rng) that a nation walks out (each walk-out cuts its trade by walkout_income_cut); candidate -> allied after candidate_minutes, Standing >= min_standing again. Allied worlds stay theirs. ally: native ships (SystemShip with AllyOf = the player, Owner -1), weak, never land, never destroyed for now; classes by weight, names, travel_scale x the flagship's flight time, escort_delay_seconds after the flagship leaves, scout_sweep_seconds to chart a body. aggressive: natives with an aggressive temperament at awareness >= from_awareness refuse contact with every player who has Charted them for refuse_minutes (again after each shoot-down), and from shoot_from_level shoot down a player's satellites and working posts over their world (shoot_chance a minute each, sim.Rng): lost, and shoot_down_standing on Starfleet Standing (Prime Directive eras). Any incident on a world (a post found, a forced contact) makes its natives refuse contact with that player for refuse_after_incident_minutes. unrest: after a first contact that ends in culture shock, once trade starts that world pays only trade_share of its trade income for minutes minutes, and its natives stay unsettled until then (CultureShockSecondsLeft runs on to the end of it; their awareness is held at awareness_floor or above while it lasts). freighter: each trade partner (or better) of a player sends a native trade freighter (SystemShip with TradeFor = the player, Owner -1; not neutral traffic, not an ally) between its world and the colony body every interval_minutes, timed to reach the colony on a whole minute (when trade is paid), dwell_seconds there, then home; travel_scale x the flagship's flight time; names by weight of a counter. spacefaring: civilizations of from_level or more (L6) are stronger partners: trade x trade_multiplier, at least ally_ships ally ships at every trade stage, partner_minutes / candidate_minutes in place of membership's; but a player whose Starfleet Standing is below low_standing gets low_standing_shock more culture shock and is turned away at the start with low_standing_refuse_chance (sim.Rng; they then refuse contact for refuse_after_incident_minutes). advance: an L4 world reaches L5 (warp) with chance_per_min (owner: rare, about 1 in 10 over a 30-minute game) + awareness x per_awareness each minute (sim.Rng); if its awareness rose by wreck_spike or more in that minute the attempt is wrecked with wreck_chance (the level stays).
